review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked its main definitions against existing Mathlib. `pullback` is a thin abbrev over `CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.pullback_monoidHom` from Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousMap/CompactlySupported.lean. It reuses that definition and adds only the IsSES-specific closed-embedding argument, so it is not a competing version. `pushforward` (fiber integration over A, as a linear map of compactly supported functions) and `integrate` are new constructions. A grep for other `pushforward`, `integrate` and `pullback_monoidHom` definitions found nothing for compactly supported continuous maps. `inducedMeasure` is built from the existing `RealRMK.rieszMeasure`, which is reuse. I found no independent duplicate concept and no practical case for consolidation, so I abstain. I did not search every possible quotient-measure or Weil-formula development for overlap.
